title: Order Acceptance Terms of the Corporate Catering Service Agreement
content:
An order under a Corporate Catering Service Agreement is accepted against the published lead time for the service level, measured in whole hours from the moment the order reaches Larkspur Table to the service start time on the service date.

### Notice bands

| Notice held at the moment the order reaches Larkspur Table | Treatment |
| --- | --- |
| At or beyond the standard lead time printed against the service level | no rush surcharge |
| Inside the standard lead time but at or beyond the shortest accepted notice | the rush percentage printed against the service level, on the order value |
| Inside the shortest accepted notice | declined outright; no rush surcharge can buy it in |

### Which agreements take orders

An order is only taken on an agreement that stands active, and an agreement in credit review, on credit hold or closed takes no orders at all. The state the agreement stands in is read from the company's own agreement record before the order is taken.

### Value and guest count

The order must reach the minimum order value printed against the service level and sit between the smallest and largest guest counts printed against it. An order below the minimum value is offered at the minimum value rather than declined, while an order above the largest guest count is referred to the private event and banquet desk.

### Channel

Orders taken by telephone carry the telephone surcharge printed against the service level, and the same order placed through the client ordering portal does not; a service level whose portal is not enabled carries no telephone surcharge at all because telephone is its ordinary channel.

### Calendar

Orders served in the declared peak weeks carry the peak surcharge printed against the service level, and orders falling on a published blackout day are not taken in any channel.

### Dietary meals

Allergen and dietary meals must be asked for at least the dietary lead hours printed against the service level before service, and a dietary request made later than that is answered with the standard menu rather than a built meal.
